text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sirius! That planner you bought at the 
school store, I had my eye on it this 
whooole time, y'know?! It's pretty pricey, 
too! I even saved up for it!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: That's why I bought it. For you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I got a present! Thank you! 
...Gaaahhh, shucks!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Knock off that overly suave routine 
already! Don't just smoothly whip out your 
wallet! Don't lean down and whisper in my 
ear! And don't casually ask if there's 
anything else I want on top of that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, that attitude of yours is pretty 
cool. I get why the juniors are all 
fangirling over you. But y'know—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It just ain't in my nature! I don't need 
anyone doting on me as they please!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So look forward to your next birthday, 
alright? For everything you did today, I'm 
gonna pamper you right back twice as hard.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oho... Well, well. And just how do you 
plan to dote on me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First off, I'm makin' a whole bunch of 
takoyaki! The little ones love 'em to 
bits! They're so good, your cheeks'll fall 
right off!!
